Dean’s Award for Enterprise Scholarship 2022 is an initiative by Loughborough University London for postgraduate degree applicants. The scholarship encourages entrepreneurially minded applicants to develop innovative business ideas. The selected candidates will receive 90% of the total cost of tuition fees for any full-time master's programme at the university. They will also receive a package of support and activities on offer throughout the year from the careers and employability team and access to the Loughborough Enterprise Network (LEN) Start-up Fund, bookable business advice sessions with the University's Entrepreneur in Residence.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Hold a conditional/unconditional offer to study a full-time master's programme
The selected candidates will receive 90% of the total cost of tuition fees for any full-time master's programme at the university.

They will also receive a package of support and activities on offer throughout the year from the careers and employability team and access to the Loughborough Enterprise Network (LEN) Start-up Fund, bookable business advice sessions with the University's Entrepreneur in Residence.
One slide deck of maximum 5 slides
The size of the file must not be more than 1GB in size.
The files must be uploaded in Word, Excel, PPT, PDF, Image, Video, and Audio format.

The candidates will be selected based on the fulfilment of eligibility criteria and will be asked to complete a short video interview.

The panel is looking for candidates with an enterprising mind and innovative ideas. It welcomes applications from individuals who are committed to contributing to society. The applicants should display a full understanding of the costs involved in postgraduate study and outline why they have a strong motivation to study the programme.
The applicants should also demonstrate that they have the initiative to be able to secure funds in order to cover the remaining tuition fee and other associated costs.
The selected awardees will be encouraged to engage with the university's pre-accelerator programme.
The scholarship is open for offer holders at Loughborough University London.
The scholarship will replace any other Loughborough University scholarships or bursaries that may already have been awarded to the successful candidates.
A business plan or document that is longer than 5 slides and a video over 90 seconds will not be accepted. If the applicants do not follow these directions the panel will not review the submission.
